name: Mod Editor
description: Open a mod (a folder, an .mpq, a mod's .exe or a .zip) and edit its tables, strings, animation scripts and AI scripts beside the map. The editor draws with the mod's files as you change them: change a unit's hit points and the Unit Settings default follows. Save as an MPQ or as a folder of text, see what changed, check it, and play it on the play page.
author: Jeany
